meta.title: Government Media Censorship Effort (V-Dem)
meta.summary: Does the government directly or indirectly attempt to censor the print or broadcast media? V-Dem expert-coded measurement-model estimate, roughly −3 to +3.5: below −1 means attempts to censor are routine; above +1.9 means the government rarely attempts to censor major media and officials who try are usually punished. 2018–2025.
